NewEvents.Title: braindance_2026: DJ HEARTSTRING + echofarmer, Effy, BOY&GIRL, KŌMA, Fafi Abdel Nour, Helena Lauwaert, offcircuit, Saidah
NewEvents.Description: braindance_ is back! AB’s platform for pioneering DJs, bedroom producers and live electronic acts celebrates its fifth birthday on Friday 18 December and will do so in style. DJ Heartstring has been on our wishlist for a while now, and finally the moment has arrived: we’ve managed to get hold of the German DJ duo. What’s more, they’ll be taking charge of the entire night and inviting their favourite Belgian and international DJs to join them in making it an unforgettable night. The entire AB complex will be transformed into a steamy nightclub, complete with impressive light show. More than ever, we’re spotlighting artists from our own talented scene. Expect a night full of musical discoveries that will get both your feet dancing and your grey matter working. DJ Heartstring Berlin-based duo DJ Heartstring has become a permanent fixture on the international electronic music scene over recent years. In their self-proclaimed Trance Dance Music (TDM), Leo and Jonas combine euphoric trance, heavy beats, nostalgic pop melodies and melancholy. From Berghain to major festival stages: their energetic sets go down well everywhere. Their debut album Sentimental Ultra is due for release in November 2026, featuring collaborations with the likes of Sam Gellaitry , SWIM and Saidah . BOY&GIRL Belgium’s BOY&GIRL unites two musical worlds: his love of hard trance and her passion for bass-driven techno. The result is a playful, sturdy mix of trance, techno, hard house and bouncy grooves.

NewEvents.Title: Impro 'Night Aladar + Aladar
NewEvents.Description:
﻿ Impro’Nights is a concept by ALADAR that blends open mics and jam sessions. At the start of the evening, the audience is free to use the stage for a short performance in their chosen medium: music, dance, poetry, performance art, …

Then the jam begins; anyone can come on stage to sing, rap, dance, play an instrument, improvise…

ALADAR is a multidisciplinary artists’ collective, founded in Brussels by young artists from diverse backgrounds, cultures and artistic practices. They offer a lively, welcoming and authentic space where everyone can create, share and express themselves artistically without pressure, hierarchy or required qualifications.

In Brussels slang,

‘à la dar’ means ‘at home’:

and that is exactly what ALADAR aims to offer.

NewEvents.Title: Tommigun + uma shanti dew
NewEvents.Description:
A new Tommigun album . Ten years on from the last one: ‘Wooden Son’.

Coming home after all sorts of wanderings? Is that it? Coming home to that ugly, beautiful city, Brussels. Brussels is actually simple. The city moves you and then you want to lose yourself in it; or it doesn’t, and then you want to get away from it as quickly as possible. Brussels, Tommigun’s home town.

Songwriter Thomas Devos creates small, simple sketches of a few chords and a vocal melody in his music room in Molenbeek. He then takes these to Tommigun at Joeri’s garden shed on the outskirts of Brussels. The magic lies in the simplicity and the different personalities who bring it to life. Their heartbreak-hangover tunes are bittersweet songs with an underlying menace and the occasional searing outburst. A bit like Brussels. Raw and unpredictable, but with a great zest for life, despite everything. And with ‘Heavy Bones’, a fresh perspective has been opened up.

The album ‘Heavy Bones’ feels like a statement: ‘Heavy bones, heavy bones, I know… yes we head to the bones, head to the bones I know…’ We’re all on our way to the end, but not without throwing an intense party first.

Thomas Devos: Vocals, Guitar Kaat Arnaert: Vocals Pim De Wolf: Bass Joeri Cnapelinckx: Keys Bertel Schollaert: Saxophone Mattijs Vanderleen: Drums

NewEvents.Title: Ino Casablanca
NewEvents.Description:
This is a Liveurope concert, the first European initiative that supports concert venues in promoting emerging musical talent from Europe.

Ino Casablanca, a Franco-Moroccan artist born in Spain, draws on his multicultural background to create a hybrid style of music blending rap, acoustic and electronic sounds, as well as Maghreb, Caribbean and Latin influences. Self-taught, he began composing at the age of 14. Following the EP Tamara , which showcased his innovative and personal approach, he released Extasia a few months later. Neither ostentatious nor contrived, the Franco-Moroccan artist crafts instinctive music, fuelled by rhythms from afar and melodies that know no boundaries, thereby gradually establishing himself on the Francophone music scene.

NewEvents.Title: Susobrino
NewEvents.Description: Susobrino , the Brussels-based artist of Bolivian origin, returns to AB after his sold-out show to promote the album SU SO BRI NO , in 2024. However, this time he’ll be performing in the Main Hall with a new album that is entirely dedicated to cumbia. He explores, dissects and reinterprets the genre by way of his distinctive blend of acoustic and electronic sounds, complemented by surprising guest appearances. Susobrino is known for his performances that effortlessly shift between emotionality and danceability. At AB, he brings his unique combination of Latin American roots and electronic explorations to the stage once again. A Friday evening in which concert and afterparty converge, curated by Susonidos. VAMOS!

NewEvents.Title: Anne Clark & Band
NewEvents.Description:
Anne Clark returns in 2027 with “Edge Of Silence,” a tour set against a world that feels close to its own breaking point. She steps back into the spotlight as a witness rather than a commentator, using decades of creative evolution to frame a moment marked by tension and uncertainty. Since the early eighties, Clark has been one of the defining figures linking electronic music, spoken word and post punk. Her influence threads through both underground movements and mainstream culture. Concert halls across Europe, the USA and Canada have carried her voice. Tracks like “Sleeper in Metropolis” and “Our Darkness” remain touchstones for listeners who grew up with them and for younger audiences discovering them anew. The 2027 tour is not a retrospective. It leans on her history only to sharpen the present. Clark and her band construct a sound that shifts between electronic edge and acoustic detail. Long familiar pieces reappear with a more distilled focus. New material looks directly at a world where calm is fragile. “Edge Of Silence” offers a space stripped of distraction. Words and sound are placed with precision.

Atmosphere matters as much as impact. Clark performs with the clarity of someone who has seen cultural cycles rise, fall and return in unexpected forms. Her voice has followed audiences through many unsettled periods. In 2027, she stands at another threshold, observing it with the same steady lens that has defined her work for more than four decades.

NewEvents.Title: Uncle Acid & The Deadbeats + Conan, Earth Tongue
NewEvents.Description: Uncle Acid & The Deadbeats is the brainchild of Kevin Starrs and has been creating a highly idiosyncratic blend of psychedelic rock, blues and proto-metal since 2009. With dark vocals, compelling melodies, heavy riffs and a generous dose of psychedelia, the British band creates a sound that feels both familiar and utterly unique. They draw inspiration from the dark history of heavy music, but put their own distinctive spin on it. The result: a sultry, macabre and hypnotic sound that comes into its own even more intensely when performed live.

NewEvents.Title: Ferdi
NewEvents.Description: Ferdi is a rising star in the Brussels-Paris music scene in recent years. He lives in the Belgian capital and is originally from France. After 15 years of training at the conservatory, he decided to pursue a career in music production, quickly becoming a key figure on the current scene and launching his solo project. He soon began collaborating with artists such as pianist Sofiane Pamart, the king of funk Dabeull, and his friend, trumpeter Béesau. Following his critically acclaimed debut solo EP, “Val Duchesse,” he decided to collaborate with Dabeull on an album that bridges their two musical worlds. This musical collaboration quickly became a natural fit, and the result can be enjoyed on the album “ Romance ,” released on September 8, 2024. In the vein of his first EP, Ferdi released his debut solo album, “TAKE 01,” in 2024, blending jazz and indie-pop.

NewEvents.Title: Adam La Nuit
NewEvents.Description:
Enter the world of Adam La Nuit , where rumba, chanson, poetry and alternative pop come together. This Belgian-Congolese artist makes music about growing up between worlds, languages, families and different versions of yourself.

His universe runs through Kinshasa, Liège and Brussels . Kinshasa is the childhood paradise that still lives on in his music as a vivid memory. Liège represents adolescence, returning to Europe, solitude, rebellion, parties, music and the start of finding his own voice as an artist.

Family, memory, identity, desire and everything we inherit from the people before us all find their way into his music. His songs move between celebration and solitude, softness and intensity, romance and survival, the personal and the political.

He describes his work as a form of magical realism : a space where day and night meet, where the sun rises while the moon and stars are still visible. His stage name reflects this idea: in the night, the stars become visible.

His world is sensual, spiritual and cinematic, with influences ranging from Alexander McQueen and Frank Ocean to Mbilia Bel .

Adam La Nuit brings his latest album Entre Nous/Deux to AB Club. You’re gonna want to be there!

NewEvents.Title: Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul
NewEvents.Description:
Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul open a new chapter. Following the internationally acclaimed Topical Dancer , the Belgian duo returns with Mainland Madinina , an album that took shape between Belgium and Martinique and was again co-produced by Soulwax.

Their quirky mix of electro-pop, house, synth-pop and post-punk saw Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul become one of Belgium’s most striking acts over recent years. Their sharp humour and socially critical perspective earned them praise from the likes of Pitchfork, The Guardian and BBC 6 Music. They also conquered international stages, from Glastonbury and Sónar to Pitchfork Festival Chicago and Later... with Jools Holland.

On Mainland Madinina , they broaden their horizons once again. Themes like grief, parenthood, migration and colonial legacies form the common thread through an album that sounds both personal and adventurous. Adigéry gives us her strongest vocal performance to date. Her emotional openness goes hand in hand with the playful, provocative energy that makes the duo so appealing.

Those who have seen Charlotte Adigéry & Bolis Pupul perform live know that their concerts are much more than just a gig. They are an exuberant celebration in which urgency, humour, danceability and unexpected twists converge. In February 2027, they will embark on an international tour to present Mainland Madinina live.

NewEvents.Description:

anaiis is a London-based French-Senegalese artist whose sound blends neo-soul, R&B and jazz. Born in Toulouse, she grew up between Dakar, Dublin and Oakland. The work of artists and thinkers such as Ella Fitzgerald, Nina Simone , James Baldwin , bell hooks and Octavia Butler helped her find her own voice.

Her debut EP, Nina , was released in 2018. Since then, she has performed alongside artists including Erykah Badu and toured as a support act for Daniel Caesar and Mereba .

Her album Devotion & The Black Divine centres on the journey of coming home to oneself. The album explores identity, motherhood, knowledge and self-acceptance. On tracks such as Sunshine and P4P , joy and anger, pleasure and justice come together. Live, this translates into an intimate, warm performance driven by powerful vocals and live instrumentation.

“Her powerful voice soothes with words of affirmation over a soft, skipping neo-soul bassline.” ( Crack Magazine)

NewEvents.Title: Thylacine + Cécile Lacharme
NewEvents.Description:
Following the success of his new album Roads vol. 3 and after selling out the AB (Brussels) and the OM (Liège) in January, Thylacine has already announced his return to Brussels! To mark the occasion, he’ll be returning to rock the capital with two new dates.

Sometimes you have to uproot yourself to find harmony with yourself and the world around you. It is certainly based on this principle that Thylacine has decided to continue his creative quest. For his new album, ‘Roads vol. 3,’ the artist decided to step away once again from the creative routines of his Paris studio. He, who admits to struggling to compose two tracks in a single location, decided this time to spend three months exploring a new continent. William Rezé-Thylacine gave himself the time he needed—the time that’s missing when you’re bogged down in the routine and rhythm of touring, the time required for travel to become an authentic experience and for intuition to transform into something ever more daring and original. This album is the embodiment of an astonishing journey. A veritable creative whirlwind, the result of profound reflections on his art and practice in the face of the delicate balances of the world around him. A new musical odyssey that makes Thylacine a fundamentally one-of-a-kind artist.

Support : Cécile Lacharme Cécile Lacharme explores the cello with a sensitive and modern approach as the unique musician that she is.

NewEvents.Title: The Warning
NewEvents.Description:
The Warning are a Mexican rock trio centred around sisters Daniela, Paulina and Alejandra Villarreal from Monterrey. With heavy riffs, loud drums and catchy choruses, they straddle the line between indie and hard rock. Following their international breakthrough with ERROR (2022) and Keep Me Fed (2024), they have become one of the most striking modern rock bands of the moment. With their fifth album, Everything’s Falling, the sisters are continuing their rise to prominence. The single “Kerosene” reached number one on the Billboard Mainstream Rock Airplay chart, making The Warning the first Mexican band – and the first all-female band – to top the chart.

PACKAGE DESCRIPTIONS (VIP1) The Warning: Meet & Greet Package One (1) General Admission Concert Ticket Meet and Greet with The Warning Individual Photograph with The Warning Autographed Exclusive 8x10 Commemorative Souvenir VIP Laminate & Lanyard Early Entry into the Venue Crowd Free, Pre-Show Merchandise Shopping

(VIP2) The Warning: Priority Entry Package One (1) General Admission Concert Ticket Priority Entry into the Venue Autographed Exclusive 8x10 Commemorative Souvenir VIP Laminate & Lanyard Crowd Free, Pre-Show Merchandise Shopping

NewEvents.Title: Sam Sauvage
NewEvents.Description:
Sam Sauvage , originally from Boulogne-sur-Mer, embodies a new untamed voice in French pop music. Nominated for a Victoires de la Musique award in the Male Newcomer category, he has just released his first album, Mesdames, Messieurs !, an intense record where the intimate, the social and the political collide head-on.

It is above all on stage that Sam Sauvage fully imposes his singularity. Possessed, confrontational, visceral, he embodies and lives each of his songs. A powerful voice and a tense body serve an unadorned interpretation forged through concerts, festivals and opening acts (Zaho de Sagazan, Eddy de Pretto, Clara Luciani, etc.).

Each concert is an emotional release, where the urgency of the lyrics and the sincerity of the performance leave a lasting impression. Sam Sauvage is an artist of the moment, of risk, of life.

NewEvents.Title: Palaye Royale
NewEvents.Description:
The stars of the avant-garde rock scene, Palaye Royale , are back with a bang! With a sixth studio album, ‘Amsterdamage’, due out on 22 January, and a major world tour, the American trio are set to make a big splash.

Formed in 2008 in Las Vegas by the brothers Remington Leith, Sebastian Danzig and Emerson Barrett, Palaye Royale have now racked up over a billion streams thanks to hit tracks such as ‘Lonely’, ‘Mr. Doctor Man’ and ‘No Love In LA’. In 2024, they were devastated by the death of their mother, Stephanie Rachel, who passed away from cancer. She was the first to instil in them the belief that art is a priceless treasure, and she was also their greatest source of support. Faced with this ordeal, their creative bond became a force that helped them move forward together. Scheduled for release on 22 January, ‘Amsterdamage’ symbolises this rebirth, like a phoenix rising from the ashes. Written throughout 2025 between two intensive tours, the album took shape between San Diego and the Netherlands, before being finalised in Los Angeles at Chris Greatti’s studio (Poppy, YUNGBLUD, WILLOW). A first single is already available. Inspired by the British bands of the mid-2000s that shaped their youth, “Lost In Translation” is an explosive track, tailor-made for the stage, which bodes well for this new album and the accompanying tour.

NewEvents.Title: Loïc Nottet
NewEvents.Description: A new story begins: driven by new music and a brand-new live show, Loïc Nottet returns to unveil a new chapter of his artistic universe, freer, more intimate, and as flamboyant as ever. From France to Belgium, with Luxembourg along the way, the date is set. After three years away from the stage, Loïc Nottet is preparing for his long-awaited return. First introduced to a wide audience through the multi-certified hits Million Eyes and Mr/Mme, the Belgian artist has never stopped exploring the boundaries between pop, emotion, and performance, crafting a distinctive world where every detail matters. In Belgium, join him at Ancienne Belgique (Brussels) on April 28 and 29, 2027.

NewEvents.Title: FIXKES
NewEvents.Description:
Once upon a time, there was a town. It had a tree. That tree had to go. Why? Just because. The wizard came along, with a smile and a mandate. “I’ll give the tree a second life,” he said. And hey presto, the tree became cupboards, chairs and tables, made from the finest wood the town had ever seen. Everyone was happy. Another day tomorrow.

‘Dooiebomendag’, Fixkes’ new single, is the first track from their sixth (promising) album, due for release in spring 2027.

Almost silently, Fixkes have established themselves as a force to be reckoned with. There was that massive breakthrough hit ‘Kvraagetaan’, back in 2007 (four months at number one in the charts, a record that stood for 13 years), and afterwards things went a lot quieter around the Antwerp band, but Fixkes kept at it. They kept refining their lyrics and songs, occasionally swapping the delicate for a gritty guitar solo or a touch of hip-hop. And they just got better and better.

Always with that witty, sometimes ironic take on life’s little quirks, wrapped up in what has now become a solid collection of simply good songs. Just check them out: Dardennen, Neukvriendje, Koriander van den Turk, Nooit niks, Goochelmonnetje, Ongelukkig, Buitenmens, Lievelingsdier… It must be just about the most common compliment you hear after a Fixkes gig: ‘I didn’t know you had so many good songs.’ It’s going to be a treat at the Club!

NewEvents.Title: uwase
NewEvents.Description:
uwase started making music in her bedroom. Not with the intention of releasing it, but to create a safe space for herself. When her family heard her songs, they said: “If you don’t release them, we’ll leak them ourselves.”

That’s how her debut EP, Perfect Blue, was released in 2021, followed by Pink Skies Ahead in 2022. After winning Studio Brussel’s De Nieuwe Lichting in 2025, she gained national attention for her acclaimed EP Angelo. This also earned her a MIA nomination in the ‘Breakthrough’ category in January 2026.

As both a performer and a producer, uwase shapes every aspect of her sound and artistic direction herself. Inspired by producers such as Blood Orange and artists such as Caroline Polachek, she approaches music with a keen eye for detail and atmosphere. Her influences range from contemporary voices such as Phoebe Bridgers and Lorde to the timeless energy of bands such as Phoenix and LCD Soundsystem.

She has just completed the writing, composition and production process for her debut album, due for release in early 2027. Once again, she is collaborating on the project with her co-producer Jasper Segers (Balthazar, Sylvie Kreusch, Oriana Ikomo).

uwase is returning to AB to showcase her music, but this time she’ll be performing at AB Box. Bigger and better.

NewEvents.Title: Tröckener Kecks
NewEvents.Description: What nobody thought possible is actually going to happen next year. Twenty-five years after the curtain fell, and the Tröckener Kecks bid farewell to their audience with their monumental live album ‘Meer Niet!’, the Kecks are set to perform again next year! The Kecks, known for their electrifying performances and songs such as ‘Nu Of Nooit’, ‘De Jacht Is Mooier Dan De Vangst’, ‘Niemand Thuis’ and ‘Met Hart en Ziel’, will embark on an extensive festival tour from spring ’27, followed in the autumn by a series of gigs on the club circuit. But their very first Belgian gig will be at the AB!

NewEvents.Title: The Wailers
NewEvents.Description:
In 2027, The Wailers will celebrate the 50th anniversary of Exodus , the legendary album released by Bob Marley & The Wailers in June 1977, and named the greatest album of the 20th century by TIME magazine in 1999. Led by Aston Barrett Jr. , son of legendary bassist Aston “Familyman” Barrett , and featuring vocalist Mitchell Brunings , the band brings the timeless music and powerful messages of Exodus to audiences around the world. The album includes iconic songs such as Jamming , Three Little Birds , One Love , Waiting in Vain , and of course Exodus .

The tour celebrates five decades of reggae history, honouring the legacy of Bob Marley while passing on his universal messages of love, unity, spirituality, resilience, and hope to new generations. Combining musical authenticity with a strong family connection to the original Wailers, Aston Barrett Jr. continues his father's legacy, both on stage and through his portrayal in the biographical film Bob Marley: One Love (2024).

Still creatively active and constantly evolving, The Wailers have earned Grammy nominations for their albums One World and Evolution , blending classic roots reggae with contemporary influences. The Exodus 2027 World Tour is a celebration of a timeless musical legacy and the enduring power of reggae to connect generations. One Love! .

NewEvents.Title: Gelukkig Zijn Sessies - Finale
NewEvents.Description:
Do you want to improve your Dutch and do you enjoy singing? Then you’ve come to the right place! Every month, together with two musicians and a set list full of Dutch-language classics, we head to a different community centre in Brussels. There, we practise Dutch together – whilst singing!

Through Dutch-language songs, you’ll get to know the language better in a fun and accessible way. At the same time, you’ll discover more about Belgian culture and meet new people. Three birds with one stone!

And don’t worry: you don’t have to be Ann Christy or Clouseau. Fun and enthusiasm are what matter most. You don’t need to be a talented singer!

As we do every year, we’ll round off the season with a spectacular finale at the AB Club!

We’ll provide a pianist, a lead singer, the song lyrics and a free drink. Everyone’s welcome and the sessions are free. Registration is compulsory, though.

Take a look at our schedule and find out when we’ll be singing near you. Want to warm up your vocal cords in advance? Check out this season’s setlist here !

In collaboration with the Taalunie , Theater van A tot Z and the Flemish Community Commission (VGC) .

NewEvents.Title: GRIEG - DE KLANK VAN HET NOORDEN
NewEvents.Description:
Tickets on sale 11/06 vanaf 10 uur.

Weet je waar Grieg het liefst naar lijkt te luisteren? Naar de regen. Hij groeit ermee op in Noorwegen, waar het meer dan tweehonderd dagen per jaar lijkt te vallen, alsof het landschap er voortdurend in gesprek is met de lucht. Het is het land van fjorden die zich openen als ademhalingen, en fjelden die als stille wachters in het landschap staan.

Grieg geeft dat Noorden een stem. In de lichte schittering van de ‘Morgenstemming’, in de dreiging van ‘In de Hal van de Bergkoning’, in zijn pianoconcerto en strijkkwartet, waar lyriek en volksinvloeden elkaar voortdurend raken.

Hoe dat landschap door zijn muziek ademt, hoor je in de ontmoeting tussen Lucas Van den Eynde, het Desguin Strijkkwartet en pianist Florestan Bataillie . Bekende werken passeren, maar ook verborgen parels. Tussen de muziek door ontvouwt zich het beeld van een componist vol twijfel en vuur.
